protocol.bulk: Average of 8 alignments at fixed 262144 bytes
protocol.Xeon8375C: Two complete passes; largest bulk (tie: larger assumed GiB/s, then run 1), smallest small independently. No affinity, priority or governor changes.
protocol.M2Pro: Three complete passes; median bulk and small independently. Each run waits for no SMHasher3 process and 1-min load <4.5. No timeout bypass.
protocol.timer: Xeon TSC reference ticks; M2 calibrated monotonic-clock estimates. Printed GiB/s assumes 3.5 GHz, not measured bandwidth.

theorem.key_model: all key words independent uniform; SplitMix64 benchmarks outside theorem
theorem.PH_scope: A selected differing block at equal message lengths, or the tagged final-block equation at unequal lengths with equal block counts. Unequal active pair counts require a nonzero target.
theorem.raw_zero_product_probability: 2^(1-b)-2^(-2b); the nonzero-target qualification cannot be dropped
